errors.generic.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell us the request ID.
errors.rate_limited.title: You're going a bit fast
errors.email_provider_unavailable.title: Couldn't send the email
errors.email_provider_unavailable.body: We couldn't send your sign-in link. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.page.notFound.label: Not found
errors.page.notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
errors.page.notFound.body: The link may be mistyped, or the organizer hasn't published the event.
errors.page.notFound.foot: If you came from a shared link, ask whoever sent it.
errors.page.forbidden.label: No access
errors.page.forbidden.title: You don't manage this event
errors.page.forbidden.body: This event belongs to another organization. You're signed in as {email}.
errors.page.forbidden.foot: Only the organization that created an event can manage it.
errors.page.busy.label: Busy
errors.page.busy.title: The system is very busy
errors.page.busy.body: This page retries on its own, so you don't need to reload. Tickets you hold aren't affected.
errors.page.busy.foot: Your hold timer keeps running on the system clock while you wait.
errors.page.server.label: System error
errors.page.server.title: Something went wrong on our side
errors.page.server.body: Try again. If it keeps failing, send us the request ID below so we can look into it.
errors.page.server.foot: If you were paying, check My tickets before paying again.
